notes.summary: Four pages of Jet pictures against nickel and dime fronts with no new rules, only the calls drawn on each front. Lucky and Ringo set the slide against over and under looks, Down Down handles a spinner, Giant Rt or Lt handles a Giant look, and odd spacing gets a sort call. The center makes every middle call in Jet.

Ringo against 42 Even Spinner, 42 Under, 42 Big Abby, 42 Abby Cov 1 and 42 Tite Dbl Bug.
Down Down against spinner looks.
Giant Rt or Lt call against the Giant fronts.
Ron and Lou are only used against a G bubble, per game plan.
Possible Roger call; possible Lucky or Roger on the Mike.
Center flash signal against Jam and Mug looks.
No Hards in gun.
Tuff tag drawn with Ringo or Lucky against the bug and Abby looks.
At Games noted on several pictures.

The line gap protects with a hard run sell and the backside guard pulls to the edge man, with the back as the inside sideboard of the puller. The tight end releases. The pictures show a jump set, a one look assess, and the hot.

notes.hb: Fake 12-13 (32-33) Punch. Block the number one spot and be the inside sideboard of the pulling guard, then release to the called route.

positionNotes.OL: Jet rules, Ringo or Lucky to the screen. Against known pressure leave one for the back. Guard and tackle away from the screen use Scat rules with Big Dual at a squeeze. Playside tackle sets to invite the inside rush; the back chips if the end goes outside. Playside guard, center and backside guard block two counts then release. Backside guard adds on against a jet technique rusher and rat kills to seal the middle. Odd spacing: Sort Sort, both guards release. Both playside guard and center covered: guard first out.

notes.summary: One-back tight zone run to the weak side. Shown from 3x1 and 2x2 sets, under center as 15-14 and from the gun as 35-34. The perimeter blocks by 4-5 rules on the most dangerous man.
notes.qb: Under center: open to 5 or 7 o'clock, fix the depth on the second step, get the ball to the back as deep as you can, then set up as if to pass. Miff flips the ball handling to reverse. Gun: toes at 5 yards, tight zone gun footwork, get out of the back's lane and carry out the keeper fake. The game plan may have the QB set to pass instead.
notes.hb: Under center: 7.5 yards deep. Open step, crossover, lead step. Aim for the B gap and get downhill with the shoulders square. Gun: same footwork, but the aim is the A gap.
notes.criteria: From 2x2 the check is for slot pressure. From 3x1 there is no check: call it and run it.
alerts: Misty runs Maybe rules with a possible Insert by the backside receiver.
Miff runs Maybe rules with reverse ball handling. Against a Fup safety the motion goes to Fly, so be ready for the linebackers to slide.
Against Jam fronts the cards show a Take 2 call on the bunch side.

notes.hb: Under center: 7.5 yards deep, rocker step, aim at the A gap and press it. Read the trapper's block, then the wrapper's. Gun: bucket lead step to the B gap.
notes.criteria: Check it against any outside pressure.
alerts: Tango calls are possible by game plan. The Miff cards from Bunch show Tango on the backside.

alerts: Center Rt can go right or left.

notes.summary: 911 is the last play with the clock running, no timeouts and no time to spike: Double Rt Off 3 Jet Aggie on Turbo. Three seams bend at 10 to 12 yards against two safeties and break to open grass, the outside men run go routes on a max split, and releases and spacing decide it. Aggie is the 2x2 name, Dancer the 3x1. Sticky is for beating a challenge flag: Snug Rt 300 Jet X and Z Stick Thru on Set Hut, sticks at 5 yards, flats at 2 to 3, and a check thru outlet at 3. For a shot in that spot the call is Swoosh Swoosh, Snug Rt 3 Jet Swoosh, with the same mechanics.
notes.qb: 911 on Turbo. Sticky on Set Hut. Swoosh Swoosh for the shot.

positionNotes.Z: Omaha at 5 yards when signaled, then out of bounds.
positionNotes.X: OMAHA (5 Yds): Sell a go for 4 steps, plant on the inside foot, run an out and get the head and shoulders around. Speed cut whether inside or outside the numbers. Split to the outside edge of the numbers. Omaha at 5 yards when signaled, then out of bounds.

notes.summary: With 5 to 10 seconds left and a shot play called, the QB signals Omaha to the outside receiver when he has free access. That receiver runs a 5 yard Omaha, catches it and gets out of bounds with enough time left for one more play.
